mapper.select: UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET status = 'PROCESSING', processing_version = processing_version + 1, next_attempt_at = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM ai_knowledge_source WHERE status IN ('PROCESSING', 'FAILED') AND next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING id, processing_version
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_source SET status = 'AVAILABLE', failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = NULL, processed_at = #{processedAt}, updated_at = #{processedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_version = #{processingVersion}
